d:
Following Cyclone Arnab, Cyclone 'Murasu' has now intensified into a severe cyclonic storm. Centered over the west-central Bay of Bengal, the storm has made landfall along the southern coast of Andhra Pradesh, triggering heavy rainfall in the region. Wind speeds are reaching approximately 110 to 120 kilometers per hour, and high, powerful waves are surging in the sea.
